newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - BTPs face correction, target 132.00.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - BTPs face correction, target 132.00.

text.p: September BTPs have little upside from their current levels and may retrace as far as 132.00 before the all-time high at 133.70 can be pierced convincingly, technical analysts said on Tuesday.
"It all looks all a bit toppish to me," said Jim Dodgin, senior technical analyst at Technical Data in London. "The chances are we're likely to see a pull back towards the 131.90,92 level."
Charts show that 131.93 is the 38.2 percent retracement of the rally from 129.07 on June 10 to 133.70 on June 19.
By 0737 GMT, September BTPs were down 0.16 at 133.30.
"Everything needs to unwind a bit. Overall I'd be flat to rather bearish, simply because it doesn't look like it's going to go higher for a while," said Dodgin.
He said if the market did sink through the 131.92 area, it could fall another point, with 131.00, 130.90 the next stopping points. Charts show 130.90 was the daily high on June 11.
Dodgin said the upside looked limited. "I'd be very surprised if we get through there (133.70)."
David Wood, an independent technical analyst near London, said the market needed to take out 133.70 to confirm another up leg targeting 134.32/36.
"But it worries me that we had that big sell-off the other day, it may be that we need another down leg to complete the correction," said Wood.
He said a move to at least 132.55 maybe even 132.00, was possible, allowing fresh impetus to the upside
Support-wise, Wood said the market must hold 133.35/20 to keep the power in the present upmove.
"I'd probably try and buy around the low 133s with a close stop and hope that takes me through," he said.
By 0756 GMT, September Eurolira was down 0.03 at 93.50 while the December contract was down four basis points at 93.86.
